messages.message: hi, my internet is down again!! 😡
Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Ravi. How can I help you today?
my wifi is barely working and i cant even load a page. its so frustrating
I am sorry to hear that you're experiencing these connection issues. I know how annoying it is when your internet is slow.
exactly. i just want it fixed now.
I can definitely look into this for you. Could you please provide your account number and full name for verification?
My name is Michael Mehta, account number 53773065.
Thank you, Mr. Mehta. Let me check the line status for your area. One moment please.
hope it works. my phone is 99206 73058 if you need it.
Thanks. I see a signal drop in your neighborhood. It looks like a network fault in the local hub.
so what happens now? i need it for work
I will raise a network ticket right now to get our engineers to prioritize the repair in your area.
oh okay, that sounds good. thanks for the quick response Ravi
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've raised the ticket and the engineers will update the status. Goodbye!
